status: Declared before the new numeric fits and withheld-game calculations; all underlying seasons are already familiar retrospective data
purpose: Choose a transparent experimental scrimmage-consistency view and assess completed-game reliability; do not rewrite the failed historical forecasting gate

baseline.forecastGate: Historical repeated2023-2025 FBS-FCS prediction bias -0.02295530263316677 fails the unchanged +/-0.02 target; that result remains failed regardless of display choice

recentPriorCandidate.estimator: Fit a full completed previous-season graph with ridge1 and contextPriorStrength1 around the original older general priors; retain only its learned venue/division context, never team effects
recentPriorCandidate.predictiveEligibility: Reuse the existing target-excluded full-parent-week plus24h-buffer preweek features and only earlier completed-season general priors
recentPriorCandidate.evaluation: Compare fixed baseline and recent-prior candidate on the identical2024-2025 FBS game rows; report pooled and per-year FBS-FBS and FBS-FCS MSE/RMSE/MAE/bias
recentPriorCandidate.selection: Recommend recent-prior only if pooled absolute cross-division mean error improves, pooled FBS-FBS MSE is <=1.01 times baseline, and each evaluation-year FBS-FBS MSE is <=1.03 times baseline. These are declared conservative engineering comparison rules, not statistical/prospective proof. Otherwise retain baseline.
recentPriorCandidate.noTuning: No hyperparameter search or current-ranking selection; all model/prior strengths fixed in this declaration

withheldGameCheck.scope: All627 FBS-involving games in the exact saved2026 snapshot, retaining all other eligible FBS/FCS observations completed by that snapshot
withheldGameCheck.method: Remove each target game's paired observation and refit the same joint ridge model, including venue/division context. Exact Sherman-Morrison removal is permitted after brute-force proof on synthetic fixtures and numeric verification against the full joint normal equations.
withheldGameCheck.notPregame: This is an as-of-publication descriptive leave-one-game-out check; other games may occur after the omitted game's kickoff. Never label it a pregame forecast or use it to retrospectively pass the historical forecasting gate.
metrics: FBS-FBS and FBS-FCS omitted net-success-rate residuals
withheldGameCheck.interpretation: Influence and reconstruction diagnostics do not prove a uniquely correct ranking or create calibrated uncertainty intervals

publication.label: Experimental Performance - Scrimmage Consistency
publication.scope: Opponent-adjusted net success rate on provider PPA-eligible plays, including all retained game states; not a complete special-teams/turnover/scoring-opportunity grade
publication.display: Percentage points above the current measured FBS mean; preserve exact per-game score reconciliation and report source coverage
publication.retain: SOR and Predictive Strength unchanged; original failed forecasting check remains visible; individual FCS context retained
publication.rawData: No raw API responses or normalized source-stat arrays in public outputs
